# Which roles answer the type of a component's own parts?

Read this when your style plugin answers the type of a part inside a component, such as a badge, a key or a meter.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

| role | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ff-key` | fontFamily | none | `{font.mono}` |
| `--step-trail` | dimension | scales | none |
| `--track-trail` | number | none | none |
| `--tt-key` | keyword | none | `{case.none}` |

<!-- @tree end -->
